assumptions: OligoMiner's tiling and trained specificity model, and iFISH's set selection.
The alignment given represents what the probes could cross-hybridise with.
The k-mer reference or dictionary given represents the genome the probes will meet.
limits: Each stage reports what it removed and why; a probe surviving is predicted specific against what was searched, not against the genome.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which oligo set images this target best: tiled candidates meeting Tm, GC and composition, screened for off-target binding and abundant k-mers, and gathered into a set?

description: Design an in-situ hybridization probe against the subject: tile it into candidate oligos that meet a melting-temperature, G+C and composition specification, screen them for off-target binding against an alignment and for k-mers abundant in a reference, and gather the survivors into the set that images best. Merges OligoMiner's tiling, its trained specificity model and its k-mer filter with iFISH's probe-set selection; each stage reports what it removed and why.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alignment_sam.description: SAM the candidates were aligned with, for off-target screening. Without it the oligos are returned UNSCREENED and the result says so.

dnac1.description: concentration of the higher-concentration strand, typically the probe, in the melting-temperature calculation (OligoMiner `--dnac1`). In nM.

dnac2.description: concentration of the lower-concentration strand, typically the target (OligoMiner `--dnac2`). The Tm uses dnac1 − dnac2/2, so equal values halve the effective concentration. In nM.

filter_by.description: feature that defines the band of acceptable sets. Values: centrality (Centrality on the region), size (Compactness), homogeneity (Even spacing). Only applies when oligos_per_probe is set. Advanced.

filter_threshold.description: width of the band around the best set, as a fraction of its own value. Only applies when oligos_per_probe is set. Advanced.

formamide.description: formamide in the hybridization buffer; it lowers every melting temperature by about 0.65 °C per percent. In %.

hybridization_temperature.description: temperature the specificity model was trained at. Only these six exist; the coefficients change sign across the range, so an intermediate value is a different model rather than a blend. In °C. Only applies when alignment_sam is set.

kmer_canonical.description: count a k-mer and its reverse complement as one (jellyfish -C). Off as OligoMiner's dictionary is; for a dump it must match how the dictionary was counted. Advanced.

kmer_dump.description: `jellyfish dump` of a genome's k-mer dictionary, for a reference too large to count here: `jellyfish count -m 18 -L 5` then `jellyfish dump -c -L 5` keeps only the k-mers a screen at 5 acts on. Advanced.

kmer_length.description: k, the k-mer length counted in kmer_reference (OligoMiner's README builds 18); a dump carries its own. In nt. Only applies when kmer_reference is set.

kmer_reference.description: FASTA of the reference to count k-mers in, for OligoMiner's k-mer screen. Counted here, so a whole genome belongs in kmer_dump instead. Without either the oligos are returned with k-mer abundance UNCHECKED and the result says so.

kmer_threshold.description: drop an oligo holding any k-mer that occurs this many times or more in the reference.

max_gc.description: highest percent G+C to accept. In %.

max_length.description: longest oligo to accept; the tiler grows a window until one fits, so a wide range yields more probes. In nt.

max_off_target_probability.description: keep an oligo whose modelled chance of a real off-target site is below this. Only applies when alignment_sam is set. Advanced.

max_tm.description: highest melting temperature to accept. In °C.

min_gc.description: lowest percent G+C to accept. In %.

min_length.description: shortest oligo to accept. In nt.

min_tm.description: lowest melting temperature to accept, AFTER the formamide correction. In °C.

oligos_per_probe.description: oligos to gather into one probe. Leave unset to return every surviving oligo instead of a set.

origin.description: coordinate of the subject's first base, when it is a window cut from a larger sequence. Read from a UCSC-style `range=` header when the subject carries one. Advanced.

overlap.description: report every window that qualifies, including overlapping ones. Off by default because overlapping oligos cannot be used together in one probe. Advanced.

probes.description: how many probe sets to return. Only applies when oligos_per_probe is set.

prohibited.description: comma-separated subsequences an oligo may not contain; the default bans homopolymer runs, which hybridize promiscuously. Advanced.

rank_by.description: feature that ranks the sets inside that band. Values: centrality (Centrality on the region), size (Compactness), homogeneity (Even spacing). Only applies when oligos_per_probe is set. Advanced.

screen_mode.description: trained model (recovers usable probes near repeats) · unique alignment only (strict) · no alignment at all (for a sequence that should be absent). Values: lda (Trained model), unique (Unique alignment only), zero (No alignment at all). Only applies when alignment_sam is set.

sodium.description: monovalent cation concentration of the hybridization buffer. In mM.

spacing.description: bases forced between consecutive oligos. In nt. Advanced.

name: design_ish_probes

coverage.description: the coverage track, gaps, spacings and the Tm/G+C distributions a renderer draws

coveredFraction.description: fraction of the target covered by at least one surviving oligo (0-1)

explanation.description: the derivation chain: conclusion, interpretation and machinery, generated from this run

kmer.description: the k-mer screen's reading of each oligo it saw: its start, the highest count charged to it, and whether it was kept. Absent when no k-mer reference or dump was given

oligos.description: every oligo that survived all stages, in target order

probes.description: the chosen probe sets, best first, each with its oligos and its three scores

stages.description: what each stage took in, put out, and removed - with the reasons named
